metadata.title: Compute.VM Type Class
metadata.description: The VM Type Class — extends the Compute Base Class (cpu/memory/storage/storage_tier/guest_os, inherited) with VM-specific SharedDataElements, under the Liskov invariant (add or refine, never contradict). A provider Class (Compute.VM.OCPVirt, …) extends this further. The generator compiles this class + its ancestors into today's flat Compute.VM resource-type spec.

cpu.description: Unifies vcpu (VM) / cpu (BareMetal) / resources.cpu (Container) — the same concept under three names today. The provider naturalizes to its native model (kubevirt domain cpu, vSphere sockets×cores, EC2 vCPUs).

memory.description: Reconciles the drift the sweep found (VM had {hugepages,size}, BareMetal had {size}): `hugepages` becomes an optional Base element.

storage.description: The reference-discipline requirements descriptor (PVD-001) — the numeric storage requirements, unifying VM disks[].storage / BareMetal storage / Container resources. The requested performance class is the governed `storage_tier` element below, not an inline enum here.

storage_tier.description: Governed vocabulary `storage_tier` (ADR-038 §2); name-selectable but requirements-authoritative (ADR-036). Profile decides bare-vs-reference.

guest_os.description: The requested operating system, as portable requirements (image family + version), not a provider-native image id. Proposed pending the OS-standardization catalog work (task #30).

firmware.description: Governed vocabulary `vm_firmware` (ADR-038 §2); name-selectable but requirements-authoritative (ADR-036). Profile decides bare-vs-reference.

boot_order.description: Ordered boot device preference (VM-specific; not meaningful for BareMetal or Container).
